notes.content: From now until September 15th (23:59 UTC), partake in a spot of hunter-gathering and enjoy a fine 1.5x boost on all gold and reputation for goods handed to The Hunter's Call this weekend!

notes.title: Sea of Thieves Round-Up: August 2024
notes.content:
The sunny delights of August are finally heading over the horizon, which means it’s once more time to have a quick sit down and reminisce over everything we managed to get done last month. Grog rations are always plentiful on the Sea of Thieves, so fill up your tankards, settle in and let’s get right to it…

[h3]Content Update[/h3]
Things were a bit warm at the beginning of the month, so naturally sailors might have been a bit hesitant to head into the middle of the [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C-fg1juuRoI/?img_index=1]arid, volcanic Devil’s Roar[/url]. Sail that way they did, though, when word got around that [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z1ydYNdVw00]Ashen Message in a Bottle Voyages[/url] were washing up on shores throughout the region, promising [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1821487963143836142]high-value rewards[/url]. Fortuitously, volcanic activity was at a low ebb to help pirates get their hands on lucrative Ashen loot in peace – barring intervention from other crews, of course.

For the monthly [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/release-notes/3.1.1]content update[/url] in August, we kept things relatively low-key following the explosive Season 13 launch in July. Highlights included revisions to the workings of the Burning Blade and the Horn of Fair Winds, as well as a blunderbuss revamp and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lzoz4vw5Xe4]new cosmetic items[/url] in the Emporium and Outpost shops. There were also a slew of fixes, a handful more of which were added the subsequent week in a [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1829109473773854971]small hotfix[/url].

August’s smaller update was a good thing too, as we scarcely had a quiet weekend all month. First up, a [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1819312230489358459]Daily Deeds reward boost[/url] granted players extra gold and Renown, then a [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1823283412452405586]Gold & Glory Weekend [/url]expanded the boosted rewards to pirates taking on tasks of all kinds. Captain Flameheart and his loyal Servant weren’t about to be outdone, and began offering [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1826967763404886495]increased gold and rep[/url] to anyone who delivered loot to the Reapers’ door. A decision that ended up cascading into an explosion of hostility when the Factions clashed with greater force than ever during the inaugural [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1828009547253854389]Fight Nights[/url] Event. Phew. Got all that?

[previewyoutube=z1ydYNdVw00;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]News and Features[/h3]
In a month with so many Events taking place, it was hard to find a spare moment to put pen to paper. Nevertheless, we made sure to power up the old Community Spotlight and shine it on one of the most devoted Reapers the seas have ever known: [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-mutinous-mel]Mutinous Mel[/url]! No prizes for guessing which side she chose during Fight Nights. Meanwhile, the latest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1172620/view/4339866062682899192]Spotlight Showcase article[/url] on Steam recapped our Community [i]and [/i]Creator Spotlights stretching back to the start of 2024, making it a comprehensive and stress-free way to catch up if you’ve arrived on our shores since then. 

Further afield, our partners at Youtooz unveiled their latest [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1823427831197503604][i]Sea of Thieves[/i] merchandise [/url]featuring an elegantly modelled Kraken Mug and adorable Megalodon Plush, both substantially friendlier than their in-game counterparts. Well worth a look if you don’t currently have enough [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] vibes in your life!

We also took a moment to celebrate some game news beyond ourselves with the re-release of the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9NIShQMPp5A]Mayhem ship set[/url]. Bright, colourful and evocative of a franchise just as chaotic as [i]Sea of Thieves[/i], who wouldn’t want to be the minion of this [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1823361142678229322]delightful figurehead[/url]?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/9ad23891e76899e5330f977eda19405160d329fe.jpg[/img]
[h3]Videos and Streams[/h3]
A new month meant it was time for a new episode of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4Ftel7aUysk][i]Sea of Thieves[/i] News[/url], and we even pulled in an old familiar face to do it! Jon took a seat in the Tavern to walk us through the cosmetics arriving with the August update, while Production Director Drew also jumped back in to explain some of the balancing changes coming to the game through the month and beyond.

The [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] Explained series was also due a new instalment, but in fact [i]two[/i] fresh episodes were dropped to help pad out the knowledge of any sailors new to the seas. First up we explored [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ys4gkshODr0]tools and World Events[/url], before Episode 5 got everyone prepped for Fight Nights with a broad-ranging primer on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=60QG_ky0IuE]everything combat[/url].

Over in the music department, we set aside another moment to appreciate all the amazing work done by [i]Sea of Thieves’[/i] Audio team, this time by adding the contemplative [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1826894292717125794]‘Align the Stars’[/url] to all the usual music streaming platforms. Be sure to give it a listen – really, it’s a [i]stellar [/i]track. Not sorry.

[previewyoutube=4Ftel7aUysk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Social Channels[/h3]
The key to having a good month on social is to start things off with some [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7398540817222176033]solid, inspirational advice[/url] and a period of reflection on [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1819372352620171501]all the victories[/url] that you’ve achieved so far. With that foundation in place, we were free to move onto more pressing concerns like [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1819994932288909416]naming Captained ships[/url], identifying [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7400415158889237792]the impostor[/url] on a crew and finding out which pet makes the [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7403016315939671329]best cannonball[/url]. Scientific analysis complete, we broadened our gaze to [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1823721493689188465]examine approaches[/url] to piracy as a whole and concluded that the ram strat is still entirely valid, no matter what your [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1824098900531155028]figurehead might think[/url].

August was also home to all our usual social competitions and, as always, the community creativity was wonderful to see. Eight lucky [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C-TM5s0P-j_/?img_index=1]Community Hub[/url] winners had their [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C_NNMnSNgbE/?img_index=1]pursuits rewarded[/url] with the always-popular fancy hat, while two rounds of #SoTShot tested pirates’ picture-capturing abilities. Initially we dived into a colourful – [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1821924677280829756]if exhausting[/url] – round of [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C-dBSU2O8kN/?img_index=1]Summer Sports[/url], before the [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1829534813197414624]ominous Burning Blade[/url] demanded our attention and we were swarmed with pictures reminding us why [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C_TGAChPGhn/?img_index=1]Flameheart’s flagship[/url] isn’t to be trifled with.

The prizes didn’t end there either, with a [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1828817369696759887]quick comic giveaway[/url] taking place at the end of the month. After that, there was only time for [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1827338824898203843]a fast fit check[/url], [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1829451013016735754]one last jump scare[/url] and a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7405609225113636129]wild skeleton rave[/url]. [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7408196457418755361]Very demure[/url], we can all agree.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/07059dffd80d63d38bac99eb8573ba085269d98b.jpg[/img]
All of which brings us to the end of August and the end of another round-up. Even without a Season launch to contend with, we still managed to pack the month with new and exciting things to do, so thank you for coming along on the ride with us. We’ll be back next month with a summary of everything we’re currently getting up to in September, but until then, find us in all the expected social places: [url=https://twitter.com/SeaOfThieves]Twitter/X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/SeaOfThievesGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/seaofthievesgame]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/seaofthieves]YouTube[/url], [url=https://twitch.tv/seaofthieves]Twitch[/url], or via the official [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/forum]Forums[/url] and [url=https://www.discord.gg/seaofthieves]Discord[/url]. Back in a bit!

notes.title: Ветеран Xbox Майк Ибарра уверен, что консоли не исчезнут — он призвал Sony сфокусироваться на хитах и не уходить в сервисы
notes.content: Команда Xbox за последний год внесла множество изменений в собственную эксклюзивную линейку игр, выпустив на конкурирующих платформах Hi-Fi RUSH, Sea of Thieves, Grounded и Pentiment. Изначально компания пыталась успокоить поклонников, которые опасались, что более крупные тайтлы последуют той же тенденции, однако недавно была анонсирована PS5-версия Indiana Jones and The Great Circle.

notes.title: Sea of Thieves Release Notes - 3.1.1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nlkCbObKIZs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Flame Rises[/h3]
[b]Returning the Burning Blade in Battle[/b][list]
[*] Crews in command of the Burning Blade are now prevented from returning the ship to The Reaper’s Hideout while still in combat. Rival ships in close proximity to the Burning Blade will prevent it from being returned.
[*] A majority vote from the crew will now be required when pledging to become the crew of the Burning Blade, or when returning the ship to The Reaper’s Hideout.
[*] Any crew votes to return the Burning Blade to The Reaper’s Hideout will now be cleared if the ship is sailed away from the island, and the vote will need to be retaken upon returning to the vicinity.[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[b]Blunderbuss Rework[/b][list]
[*] The blunderbuss knockback effects have now been strengthened, with close-range shots now consistently propelling players forcefully backwards and applying more vertical height to repel boarders over ledges and obstacles.
[*] The spread pattern of the blunderbuss has been widened, both when firing from the hip and aiming down sights, maximising the knockback potential at close range.
[*] Players propelled backwards by a blunderbuss shot no longer have movement control while in the air, ensuring they are forced in the direction determined by the blast.
[*] New visual effects have been added to the blunderbuss, with white-hot debris, smoke and distortion effects identifying the effective range of its new knockback strength.
[*] The damage dealt by each pellet fired from the blunderbuss has been slightly reduced, reducing the total output of the weapon to 90 damage. As a result, the blunderbuss will no longer be able to perform a one-hit kill on a player with full health.
[*] Pellets fired from the blunderbuss now fizzle out at long range, reducing the overall range of the blunderbuss and cementing its role as a close-range tactical choice.[/list][b]Horn of Fair Winds Availability[/b][list]
[*] The Horn of Fair Winds is now more easily discovered within the world. These items are guaranteed to be found within Siren Treasury Vaults, and now have an increased chance of being salvaged from shipwrecks. In addition to these specific locations, there is a small chance of finding a Horn of Fair Winds washed up on islands across the Sea of Thieves.
[*] To balance out this increased availability, the gold awarded when cashing in a Horn of Fair Winds has now been reduced. As a reminder, the gold amount earned is not linked to the power remaining within the Horn, so blast away![/list]
[h3]Pirate Emporium[/h3]
Show off your personal style with purchases from the Pirate Emporium! Pick up exclusive cosmetics such as ship liveries, costumes, weapons, pets and emotes using your Ancient Coins, purchasable with real money. Head to the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/pirate-emporium]Pirate Emporium page[/url] to browse and buy the latest additions!

[b]New Items – Now in Stock![/b][list]
[*] Motley Mariner Ship Collection
[*] Motley Mariner Weapon Bundle
[*] Motley Mariner Costume Set
[*] Motley Mariner Ship’s Crest
[*] Motley Mariner Trinket
[*] Motley Mariner Drum
[*] Ashen Curse Owl
[*] King’s Ransom Weapon Bundle
[*] King’s Ransom Ship’s Crest
[*] Idle Conversationalist Emote Bundle
[*] Omen Ship Bundle
[*] Red Card Emote (free!)[/list][b]Pirate Emporium Browsing Improvements[/b][list]
[*] The Pirate Emporium store experience has been improved with an expanded ‘Browse All’ section added to the top bar, allowing players to more easily scour the wealth of items available to purchase.
[*] Within this new menu, players can filter items by category such as weapons, ships and equipment, then dive deeper to find specific types such as cannons, pistols and banjos.
[*] Players can also sort these filtered items by name or by price to help them find exactly what they are looking for.[/list]
[h3]Outpost Cosmetics [/h3]
[b]New Outpost Stock![/b][list]
[*] The Outpost clothing shops have received a fresh shipment of items and now offer the Simian Courtly Jacket and several colourful new halter tops, all available for gold.
[*] The Outpost weaponsmiths now stock a selection of weapons from the new Stonebark Carpenter’s weapon set.[/list]
[h3]Fixed Issues[/h3]
[b]Gameplay[/b][list]
[*] When attacking players with throwing knives, a missed throw will no longer incorrectly cause them to take damage.
[*] Attacking Gunpowder Skeletons with throwing knives and directly hitting the keg should now consistently detonate it.
[*] Crews diving to the submerged wreck as part of a Lost Shipment Voyage should no longer find an empty Captain’s cabin on arrival.
[*] Players are now targeted correctly by enemy Bone Caller Skeletons after migrating across servers.
[*] Crews can once again discover Chests of Ancient Tributes in the following Sunken Kingdom locations: Shrine of Ocean’s Fortune, Shrine of Ancient Tears and Shrine of Tribute.
[*] Ship Milestones for Voyage Quests Completed now increment properly depending on the crew’s size.
[*] Attempting to deliver Athena’s Fortune treasure to an Outpost will now guide players to the correct location.
[*] The Logbook of a Captained ship will no longer continue to gain progress while the crew is pledged to the Burning Blade.[/list][b]Blade of Souls[/b][list]
[*] Players can no longer bypass the stun when missing a heavy strike with the Blade of Souls by dropping the sword.
[*] The Blade of Souls is now correctly positioned in a player’s hands view while running or swimming.
[*] The Blade of Souls is now correctly stashed on a player’s back while climbing ladders.
[*] The correct icon will now show on the Map Table when a player is holding the Blade of Souls.[/list][b]The Burning Blade[/b][list]
[*] Crews pledged to the Burning Blade should no longer be open to invasion by rival crews as part of an Hourglass battle.
[*] The Burning Blade will no longer be able to enter the Tunnels of the Damned as part of a Tall Tale.
[*] Crews burying items while pledged to the Burning Blade will now find that Map Bundles appear in the Captain’s cabin.
[*] Players will now see the Burning Blade announcement banners only once upon approaching and not repeatedly when engaging or returning from the Ferry of the Damned.
[*] The banner for pledging to take control of the Burning Blade now correctly displays the name of the crew that accomplished it.
[*] If a Burning Blade crew leaves the game, nearby crews will no longer see the ‘Defeated’ notification.
[*] The crew of the Burning Blade can no longer access the Ship Customisation Chest at Outposts.
[*] The Ashen Roar will no longer get stuck and become unusable if the Burning Blade moves servers while it is heating up.
[*] Storage merfolk will now recognise the Burning Blade when the pledged crew has stored treasure in the depths of the Sunken Kingdom.
[*] Treasure from the Burning Blade’s hold will now be released and rise to the surface consistently when the ship is sunk.
[*] The allied skeleton crew on the Burning Blade will no longer react when hit by the pledged crew.
[*] The Burning Blade’s middle mast repair location has been moved to avoid the location of the bell.
[*] Losing the Burning Blade within the Devil’s Shroud no longer repeats defeat notifications for the crew and rival players nearby.
[*] Joining a session in progress on the Burning Blade no longer starts battle music if the ship is not in combat.
[*] Battle music for the Burning Blade crew now consistently starts when a ship comes into battle range and ceases when the last ship leaves.
[*] The Burning Blade will no longer fire the Ashen Roar when it is considered downed or flipped.
[*] Players can no longer become stuck in the ship’s barrels and be ejected from the ship.
[*] A notification has been added to indicate that The Reaper’s Bones Emissary Flag can’t be lowered when in control of the Burning Blade.
[*] The Burning Blade is no longer able to migrate to a location where another Burning Blade is already present.
[*] Completing Rituals at a Skeleton Camp now requires the Burning Blade to be closer to the island.
[*] Captains defeating the Burning Blade should now consistently be rewarded with the Blade of Souls.
[*] Bone Caller Skeletons will now appear on the Burning Blade when summoned.
[*] Players using Controller Aim Assist will no longer find that allied skeletons on the Burning Blade trigger the assist effects.
[*] The Blade of Souls will only be shown next to Captain Flameheart while the Burning Blade is not roaming the seas.
[*] Improvements have been made to the visual quality of the carpet in the Captain’s cabin on the Burning Blade.
[*] While sailing the Burning Blade, the border of the Devil’s Shroud now appears in the correct locations around the world map.[/list][b]Skeleton Camps[/b][list]
[*] Improvements have been made to the Skeleton Camp and Ancient Temple environments to enhance navigation and visual quality.
[*] Constellations will now be correctly highlighted on the pillars after a failed attempt.[/list][b]Environment [/b][list]
[*] The feet of Barbary and Capuchin pets will now align properly when perched on the bar at taverns.
[*] Barrels at Blind Man’s Lagoon will now be solid and will not allow players to walk through them.
[*] Pet perch spots in the Pirate Legend Hideout have been updated, allowing players to place dogs in various locations.
[*] Pets in the Pirate Legend Hideout no longer partially float in the air when placed on a certain stool.
[*] The floating Wild Rose journal at the Lagoon of Whispers has been placed correctly so that it appears to sit on the surface below.
[*] Gold in the coffers at Picaroon Palms can now be collected by players.
[*] Players should no longer experience stuttering when going down the stairs at Sea Forts.
[*] [b]‘Captains of the Damned’[/b] – Players can now sit on benches at Isla Tesoro without sitting on other players.[/list][b]Visual and Audio[/b][list]
[*] Players of all body types using the Mayhem Capstan will now see their hands holding on to it correctly.
[*] Fireworks can now be heard while inside caves.
[*] The buttons on the Eclipse Jacket now display correctly if a player views it from further away.
[*] The Pirate Lord’s speech will no longer be cut off when players sail away at the end of the Captaincy tutorial.
[*] The audio effect for collecting a chicken in the Merchant Alliance Tutorial Voyage now matches other animal capture Voyages.
[*] Enemy skeleton music will no longer be heard when allied skeletons are nearby.
[*] Rolling Dice Emotes now also display a notification showing the dice roll result.
[*] Pocket Watches now consistently have visible glass faces after being equipped.
[*] Flameheart’s animations have been improved to be smoother when the Burning Blade is returned to The Reaper’s Hideout.
[*] The underside of a player’s foot is now visible when performing emotes or sitting on ledges.[/list][b]Text and Localisation[/b][list]
[*] Approved Xbox terminology is now used across a range of menu items in non-English languages.
[*] [b]‘Revenge of the Morningstar’[/b] – Incorrect translation in Tyler’s dialogue has been addressed, which previously blocked players using non-English languages.[/list][b]Performance and Stability[/b][list]
[*] Improvements have been made to server stability to avoid instances where players are disconnected from their session.[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
To learn more about known issues in [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] currently being tracked and their status, head over to our [url=https://support.seaofthieves.com/hc/en-gb/sections/360000063027-Known-Issues]Known Issues support site article[/url].

[h3]Download and Installation[/h3]
[b]Download Size:[/b][list]
[*] Steam: 1.76 GB[/list]

notes.title: Windows Central: Владельцы PlayStation 5 купили более 1 миллиона копий Xbox-хита Sea of Thieves
notes.content: Пользователи PlayStation 5 купили более 1 миллиона копий Sea of Thieves от Microsoft, сообщил портал Windows Central со ссылкой на свои источники. Пиратская адвенчура студии Rare стала хитом продаж за пределами экосистемы Xbox и побудила корпорацию активнее поддерживать сторонние платформы — вчера состоялся анонс Indiana Jones and the Great Circle для консоли Sony.

notes.title: Инсайдер: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle от Microsoft отправляется на PlayStation 5
notes.content: В начале 2024 года пошли слухи о появлении эксклюзивов Xbox на других платформах, которые вскоре подтвердил Фил Спенсер. PlayStation 5 уже посетили такие тайтлы, как Hi-Fi RUSH, Grounded, Sea of Thieves и Pentiment. Однако это явно не конец, учитывая успех этих игр на консоли Sony.

notes.title: Sea of Thieves Round-Up: July 2024
notes.content:
In all the excitement of Flameheart’s explosive resurrection and a whole new Season to keep us occupied, we scarcely noticed that the end of July was upon us and it was time to get another monthly round-up off to the printers. Never fear, though, we weren’t going to leave you hanging for long. We’re pirate writers of our word, after all.

[h3]Content Update[/h3]
While the main content update of the month was still [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wYyaR46j30A]sneaking over the horizon[/url] – as much as an enormous, flaming warship can sneak, anyway – we wanted to take a moment to celebrate the camaraderie that makes this community what it is. To that end, the [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C8_zIDvt8cX/]Flags of Friendship[/url] Event set out to reward players forming Alliances with an exclusive tattoo and tankard, as well as increased profits from any loot your allies sold.

Captain Flameheart’s grand return couldn’t be put off for long, however. With all the subtlety you’d expect from an infamous pirate skeleton, the legend himself made his reappearance with the launch of [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/season-13]Season 13[/url], bringing with him a newly rebuilt warship to outmatch anything else sailing on the Sea of Thieves.

Not only that, his loyal followers had been hard at work unearthing Ancient Temples across the map to steal the secret knowledge trapped within, setting up Skeleton Camps to protect their efforts. If you want to read up on the decidedly less secret knowledge of everything that’s new, changed and improved in Season 13, be sure to stop by the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/release-notes/3.1.0]release notes[/url], as always.

[previewyoutube=aVJxGzACJy4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]News and Features[/h3]
Over on the News page, the main event was of course the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/season-13-launch]launch day rundown[/url] of everything you could expect from the minty-fresh new Season. Before that, we’d kicked off the month in style – [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/style-of-thieves-season12]Style of Thieves[/url], that is! Season 12’s themes were revealed on the very first day of July, so that pirates had as much time as possible to get their fiercest fashions ready. You can’t rush perfection.

In Spotlight news, we stopped by another fresh [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/stream-team]Stream Team[/url] member after [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-div-and-inc]Div_And_Inc’s[/url] prior instalment, this time in the form of another familiar face to many: [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/creator-spotlight-gosfather]Gosfather[/url]! If you’re looking for tips on how to create content yourself or help to lift up other content creators if you’re already in the business, his interview is a great place to start. 

Then, fast forwarding to the end of the month, we closed things out with a topic near and dear to our hearts here at Rare: [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/disability-pride-month2024]Disability Pride Month[/url]. Accessibility is a major part of everything we do in [i]Sea of Thieves[/i], so spare a few minutes for a glimpse behind the curtain at some of the work that goes into making the seas a welcoming place for all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/d1d76cef8c4f3f55911fa5bb90eec47194d6e396.jpg[/img]
[h3]Videos and Streams[/h3]
With the inevitability of all regularly scheduled programming, the first video we released in July was a fresh instalment of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vx5PqP13ubw][i]Sea of Thieves[/i] News[/url]. As you might expect, most of the episode was dedicated to highlights of the imminent Season 13, but it also discussed the importance of the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e85gVK3RBt0]Pirate Emporium[/url], changes to certain in-game sounds and how Bone Caller Skeletons react to tucked players. Drew even revealed that pirates would be able to sprint while holding the Blade of Souls, proving once and for all that pirates aren’t caught up on basic classroom safety.

Before we got to Season 13, however, we realised that some pirates may not be all that familiar with Captain Flameheart, especially if they hadn’t been sailing long enough to remember his [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1813209028790468868]angry floating head[/url] days. To ensure everyone was up to speed [i]before [/i]pledging themselves to fight in his name, our Video team helpfully provided a whistle-stop tour of his [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ATL_J3wQFGU]dastardly deeds to date[/url].

And then it was finally time for the man himself to make his return! As always, a new Season meant a new [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aVJxGzACJy4]launch trailer[/url] and an expanded [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nlkCbObKIZs]content update video[/url] to explain everything you can do with the fearsome Burning Blade. There was even a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7394832259842329888]40-second summary[/url] for anyone who [i]really [/i]couldn’t wait to get sailing and an epic [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1816752909771477085]soundtrack addition[/url] to get everyone in the fighting spirit.

[previewyoutube=ATL_J3wQFGU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Social Channels[/h3]
July was a big month for the community, with not one but two community-organised meetups taking place! Here in the UK, [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C9XpNxdsrmi/]SoTFest[/url] had pirates descending on Walsall for a weekend, while across the pond we saw sailors gather in Ohio for [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1815893195265565184]Fest of Legends[/url]. Here at Rare, we were handing out glorious hats for a new round of [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C9cswFjsfpR/]Community Hub[/url] submissions, while the aforementioned Style of Thieves competition saw [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C9k2u-CJ30y/]the best-dressed pirates[/url] walking away with snazzy new gloves. There was even a [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1814335736604242087]Movie Moments[/url] round of #SoTShot for all the [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C9nGNuJM9iG/?img_index=1]budding photographers[/url] out there…

All that wonderful player creativity inspired us to undertake some [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C9ZW8eisY2S/]creation of our own[/url], but we quickly realised that we were better off delegating the [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1813547723032780866]important decisions[/url]. Fortunately, it didn’t take long for us to get distracted by the most important [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7389641365891714337]sporting event[/url] of the year and some [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C9M6jQRs_YV/]fishy festivities[/url] to go along with it.

By the time the Burning Blade [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7395240403886198048]AKA Big Ship[/url] made its debut, we were more than ready to celebrate all the [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7397883057715416352]new game additions[/url] and changes, no matter [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1817200321795399739]how small[/url]. Even if the celebrations got a little… [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7395953011169840416]weird[/url]. Frankly, we’ve found it’s best not to ask. The last leg of the month was spent revelling in watching everyone [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1817589354182643972]experiencing Season 13[/url] while throwing around [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1816820942326129025]free gold[/url], identifying [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1815443220836360337]S-Tier unlocks[/url] and shrugging off the odd [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7393368060557610272]minor mishap[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/5c5c21ee506f0f15d8856ecc93729160933a566a.jpg[/img]
And that, dear readers, was July. It was a hectic month with many moving parts, but well worth it to see everyone ultimately enjoying Season 13. And while you continue to do that, we’ll call time on another round-up! Until the next one, find us in all the usual places on [url=https://twitter.com/SeaOfThieves]Twitter/X[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/SeaOfThievesGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/seaofthievesgame]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/seaofthieves]YouTube[/url], [url=https://twitch.tv/seaofthieves]Twitch[/url], or via the official [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/forum]Forums[/url] and [url=https://www.discord.gg/seaofthieves]Discord[/url]. Let the Flame burn! Unless, you know, you’d rather it didn’t. That’s valid too.

notes.title: Sea of Thieves Spotlight Showcase #8
notes.content:
The next bumper crop of Spotlight shenanigans is here! After our last instalment packed in a recap of 10 whole Spotlight articles, bringing us closer to catching up with the current day, we’re now back with the all the more recent entries we couldn’t quite cram in there. It’s going to be a whirlwind to get through them, so everyone take a deep breath. Got it? Let’s go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/fb69476e7df730007010e1ae1468c5c3d78d0188.jpg[/img]
First up on our list, we’re jumping back to freezing memories of January and our Community Spotlight with roving writer [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-dead-eye-dray]Dead-Eye Dray[/url]. A keen contributor to Golden Sands Blogpost, Ancient Isles University [i]and [/i]Merfolk’s Lullaby, it’s amazing that Dray found a spare second to chat with us at all, let alone walk us through their long and storied history in the [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/708f575831e1bf5693db671c6445419634aca860.jpg[/img]
For our first Creator Spotlight of 2024 and this Showcase alike, we dropped by the deck of renowned banana cruncher [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/creator-spotlight-jon-bardcore]Jon Bardcore[/url]! From his origins as an oldest child being distracted by a NES all the way through to slamming bananas while dropping knowledge and becoming a familiar face in the YouTube guide community, he was full of insights into the world of content creation.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/75e4afada351c044bb75a1a64d7669b1caa218d0.jpg[/img]
For our next instalment we caught up with another name in the Ancient Isles University roster, [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-captain-mc-guffin]Captain McGuffin[/url]. A researcher through and through, it’s perhaps little wonder they came to [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] as an Alpha tester. Since then, serving as Head of Forensics at the University and a prominent member of [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] Portugal has made them a testament to the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/965ed4136483d27241c091e544189099f7107d8d.jpg[/img]
In March, not long after our Partner Programme welcomed in a host of new faces, we used our next Creator Spotlight to catch up with one of them: [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/creator-spotlight-pufferson]Pufferson[/url]! Best known for her endeavours as a solo Sloop skirmisher, she walked us through subjects as wide-ranging as how she fell into content creation, normalising discussions of mental health and her real-life sailing experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/1ec53c9af371bd1a6243249c297e571facc75e7b.jpg[/img]
Halfway through the list now, and we move on to [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-capn-axe]Cap’n Axe[/url]! This artwork aficionado shared some details of a background in graphic design and production design, and how it’s helped to shape their experiences producing phenomenal pieces of loot art. They even revealed that they’d worked on an Oscar-nominated film! And that they hate mint. Equally character-defining fun facts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/d71c6d1cbaac23d4528531446feeee44933662f9.jpg[/img]
The Community Spotlights continued with our next instalment and a deep dive into [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-keepinit-twisted]KeepinitTwisted’s[/url] whirlwind adventures. Between her own deep dives into [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] lore, fierce victories in PvP battles and a coveted #SoTShot win, she’s made a name for herself in almost every corner of the community. We’d expect nothing else from someone who races up 53 floors every year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/e536158db14854576c138c9a27fa75df025ae27d.jpg[/img]
Next in line, we turned to a pirate perhaps best known for his striking fashion sense: the Barnacled Buccaneer [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-fishhook-cook]Fishhook Cook[/url]! The conversation, of course, delved into his well-documented love of crustacean-cover clothing, but also took in his favourite in-game moments, achievements and real-life [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] events, before closing out on the details of an actual pirate connection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/6507122d45eb576aa708512692ccd80f96e569dc.jpg[/img]
For the penultimate Spotlight of this Showcase, we concluded our Pride Month celebrations by sitting down with Boatswain and Diversity & Inclusion advocate, [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-div-and-inc]Div_And_Inc[/url]! Despite admitting to the crime of maining Oddjob in [i]GoldenEye 007[/i], they quickly redeemed themselves with a discussion of all their work to make the [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] community a more welcoming place for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/970a8e334fc9cdc776b965e0eaa4b84c33bdbb1d.jpg[/img]
And, finally, we catch up to our most recent Spotlight victim– uh, participant: [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/creator-spotlight-gosfather]Gosfather[/url]! As a founding member of our [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/stream-team]Community Stream Team[/url] alongside fellow creators like Div_And_Inc, this spirited streamer had plenty to say about [i]Sea of Thieves[/i], content creation, being a mentor and the correct technique for eating a scone. Answers to all the important questions, really.

[hr][/hr]
All of which, at long last, brings us up to date! We have plenty more Spotlights in the works to highlight many of the wonderful people who make up this brilliant pirate community, so watch this space to catch more interviews as they happen.

Until then, don’t forget you can always check out previous [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news?type=community]Community[/url], [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news?type=creator-spotlight]Creator [/url]and [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news?type=legend-spotlight]Legend[/url] Spotlights from the [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news]News [/url]page. Or, if you’d rather take a whistle-stop tour through them in this format, be sure to stop by our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1172620/view/6181831424328799285]previous Showcase[/url] and those that came before!

notes.title: The Flame Burns Brightly in Sea of Thieves Season 13
notes.content:
The time has come: the resurrected Captain Flameheart is making moves to seize control of the Sea of Thieves. He’s returned from his long banishment with a plan, and his sights are set on retrieving long-forgotten Ancient secrets. Two of the most powerful tools at his disposal as this mission begins are his monstrous flagship, the Burning Blade... and you!

[previewyoutube=aVJxGzACJy4;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Turn Towards the Dark[/h3]
Yes, not only can the Burning Blade be found roaming the seas with fire in its belly and Obsidian Skeletons swarming its decks, Season 13 allows you to board it and declare yourself its new crew once you’ve dulled its fury with a suitable show of strength.

This means pledging yourself to Flameheart’s service, but the rewards are tempting. With ten cannons, a skeletal support crew, Obsidian Ashen Winds Skulls in the hold and the Ashen Roar fireball launcher at the bow, it’s a vessel capable of transforming a rough-and-ready pirate band into a marauding boss battle.

Serving Flameheart, for as long as you wish to do so, involves sailing the Burning Blade to Skeleton Camps found on islands across the map. These are built over Ancient Temples, sites of the lost knowledge that Flameheart craves. Solve the constellation puzzle in any of these Temples to enter the Crypt where an Ancient lies entombed, then complete the Ritual to transfer Ancient secrets to the Burning Blade. The more Rituals performed, the greater the ship’s value when you finally return it to Flameheart at The Reaper’s Hideout for your reward!

[previewyoutube=ATL_J3wQFGU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Stay Within the Light[/h3]
But there is another option. Overcome the Burning Blade and you can choose [i]not [/i]to take the wheel and sail in Flameheart’s name, but sink the ship and claim the spoils. The unique reward for doing so is the Blade of Souls, not just a coveted treasure item (with value measured by the Rituals performed before the Burning Blade was sunk), but a fully wieldable melee weapon with the power to set your enemies on fire!

There’s also a reason to visit the Ancient Temples beneath the Skeleton Camps even when you’re not pledged to Captain Flameheart. Battle your way through devout Obsidian Skeletons, solve the constellation puzzle and reach the Crypt – then instead of completing the Ritual within, sabotage it by escaping with the precious Orb of Secrets, ready to be sold to the nearest Trading Company representative who shows an interest... 

[previewyoutube=nlkCbObKIZs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Capture Those Cosmetics[/h3]
In addition to a cache of Commendations and rewards earnable as you explore Season 13’s features in different ways, the new Season brings 100 fresh levels of Seasonal Renown to be climbed. Unique cosmetics along with gold, Doubloons and Ancient Coins are all up for grabs as you progress, and an optional Plunder Pass adds more prizes to the pool: for Season 13 this includes the eerie Eclipse ship set complete with Collector’s items, plus the Eclipse Hat, Jacket and Gloves for your pirate and 750 unlockable Ancient Coins to help you recoup the price of the Pass itself.

Over in the Pirate Emporium, the owl pets from Season 12 already have some competition in the form of five fabulous varieties of tropical toucan to share in your adventures. Also new in stock are the Radiant Comet cosmetic set with a stained glass motif, so far including a ship livery, a lantern and a clutch of well-crafted weapons, while the Runway Emote Bundle should satisfy pirates who adore both fashion and drama! 

[previewyoutube=e85gVK3RBt0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Find Out More[/h3]
For more information on the [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] Season 13 update, including full [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/release-notes/3.1.0]release notes[/url], visit the [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/season-13]website[/url]. The update is available for free to all [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] players on Steam. Simply download and install the latest [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] update to get access.

New to [i]Sea of Thieves[/i]? Find out about the latest free content updates on our [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/whats-new]What’s New[/url] page, get familiar with [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/whos-who]Who’s Who[/url] or pick up some gameplay tips from our [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/pirate-academy]Pirate Academy[/url], which provides invaluable information on topics ranging from sailing to swordplay as you prepare for your maiden voyage. Join the ongoing adventure at [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/]www.seaofthieves.com[/url] where you can embark on an epic journey with one of gaming’s most welcoming communities!

notes.title: Sea of Thieves Release Notes - 3.1.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=nlkCbObKIZs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Flame Rises[/h3]
Captain Flameheart has returned, but the real star of Season 13 is his fiery flagship, awaiting crews who have what it takes to claim it for themselves! For an overview of this new Season’s headline features, head to our dedicated [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/season-13]Season 13 page[/url].

[b]The Burning Blade[/b][list]
[*] Ready your crew and take on the Burning Blade World Event! Easily spotted from afar with its telltale burning braziers and skyward beacon, this infernal ten-cannon warship will take a seasoned crew to take it on.
[*] Players who subdue the ship’s Obsidian Skeleton crew can choose to pledge service to the notorious Captain Flameheart and take control of the Burning Blade for themselves. Once in control, the crew will be assisted by Flameheart’s skeletal followers and have access to its weaponry, including Obsidian Ashen Winds Skulls to help repel boarders and the devastating Ashen Roar fired from the bow of the ship.
[*] Loyal Guardians can instead choose to completely sink the Burning Blade and claim its sizeable bounty from the wreckage. This includes the Blade of Souls, a fiery new melee weapon capable of setting foes ablaze![/list][b]Skeleton Camps[/b][list]
[*] Flameheart’s forces have constructed Skeleton Camps across the Sea of Thieves, built over the Ancient Temples hidden below the surface. Crews can discover these camps naturally on islands or dive straight to them from the Quest Table.
[*] Descending into an Ancient Temple, players must unravel the mysteries of the constellations by solving puzzles to unlock access to the Crypt Vault. There, those who oppose Flameheart can put a stop to the Ritual, snatch the Orb of Secrets and deliver it to the Trading Companies for a reward.
[*] Crews who have pledged service to Captain Flameheart and taken command of the Burning Blade, however, should complete the Rituals within the Ancient Temples to gather the lost knowledge that Flameheart seeks.
[*] As crews complete Rituals, Flameheart’s power grows, rewarding pledged pirates accordingly when they return the Burning Blade to him at The Reaper’s Hideout. Crews who instead destroy the Burning Blade and retrieve the Blade of Souls can sell it for a value depending on the Rituals performed before the ship was defeated![/list][b]Commendations and Rewards[/b][list]
[*] Crews choosing to side with the Pirate Lord and sink the Burning Blade will unlock access to items from the Obsidian Bone Crusher set, with ship parts, clothing items and weapons all available to earn.
[*] Those instead choosing to pledge to Flameheart and sail the devastating Burning Blade can unlock the Burning Blade Reborn ship set, and Servants of the Flame who have already drunk from Flameheart’s chalice can unlock new skeleton cosmetics and bone colours when crewing the Burning Blade as skeletons.
[*] Players taking the Orbs from the Temples can unlock the Cracked Orb Lantern, and those seeking to steal the Orbs from unsuspecting crews can earn the Reaper’s Bones Shattered Mask.
[*] Descending deep into the Ancient Temples below the Skeleton Camps to unravel their mysteries will unlock access to new tattoos for your troubles.[/list]
[h3]Season 13[/h3]
Another Season means 100 new levels to climb by raising your Renown, with racks full of rewards to snag along the way – and an optional Plunder Pass adding even more. Emissaries aren't forgotten either, with the latest Company-themed cosmetics for qualifying Ledger performances!

[b]Season 13 Rewards and Plunder Pass[/b][list]
[*] Progressing through the 100 levels of Renown in Season 13 will reward players with Bloodstone Dragon cosmetics alongside other time-limited Seasonal specials. Head to the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/profile/seasons]Seasons [/url]profile page to browse the new rewards and check your pirate’s progress!
[*] Pick up the latest Plunder Pass to gain access to a plethora of additional unlockable cosmetics from the Eclipse set, including a full ship set plus the Jacket, Hat and Gloves, all available to earn by raising your Renown. Purchase a Pass in-game through the Pirate Log or Pirate Emporium, via the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/pirate-emporium]Pirate Emporium webpage[/url] or the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/itemstore/1172620/detail/121/]Steam Item Store[/url].[/list][b]Season 13 Emissary Ledger Rewards[/b][list]
[*] This Season, the Guild Emissary Ledgers offer the ‘Secrets of the Ancient Flame’ Painting, Dark Hand of Fate Ornament and Guild of Fiery Spirits Title to Guilds who represent them well and perform proudly in the Ledgers.
[*] The Trading Company Emissary Ledgers have been refreshed this month with the previously lost Pocket Watches. Players can therefore now earn the Tribute Peak, Relic of Darkness, Merchant Ambassador, Masked Renegade and Magpie’s Glory Pocket Watches when reaching the top tier of the Ledgers. Players who have previously unlocked all rewards within the Ledgers will find these new Pocket Watches already in their Equipment Chests![/list][b]Chest of Fortune[/b][list]
[*] The Chest of Fortune has now been locked away in the belly of the Burning Blade, challenging crews to sink this formidable ship to claim its prize.
[*] Crews who retrieve Chests of Fortune can now earn the next Grade of the Fortune’s Favour Commendation, unlocking access to the Fates of Fortune Fishing Rod, Shovel, Pocket Watch, Tankard and Speaking Trumpet.
[*] An additional reward has been retroactively added to Grade II of the Fortune’s Favour Commendation, which now contains the Fates of Fortune Gloves. Players who already earned Grade II prior to this update will be able to purchase the gloves from the Outpost clothing shops straight away.[/list][b]Reaper’s Chests[/b][list]
[*] Crews chasing down the telltale beacon of the Reaper’s Chest or Reaper’s Bounty can earn the next Grade of the Reaper’s Riches Commendation, and start unlocking access to the Fates of Fortune Hurdy-Gurdy, Concertina and Scar.[/list]
[h3]Pirate Emporium[/h3]
Show off your personal style with purchases from the Pirate Emporium! Pick up exclusive cosmetics such as ship liveries, costumes, weapons, pets and emotes using your Ancient Coins, purchasable with real money. Head to the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/pirate-emporium]Pirate Emporium[/url] to browse and buy the latest additions!

[b]New Items – Now in Stock![/b][list]
[*] Radiant Comet Ship Collection
[*] Radiant Comet Weapon Bundle 
[*] Radiant Comet Lantern
[*] Cloudburst, Treetop, Brightbill, Seaspray and Sugarspun Toucan pets
[*] Runway Emote Bundle
[*] Mayhem Ship Bundle
[*] Sting Tide Cutlass (free!)[/list]
[h3]Outpost Cosmetics [/h3]
[b]New Outpost Stock![/b][list]
[*] Outpost clothing shops have received a shipment of brand new items and now offer the Proud Plume clothing set, available for gold.
[*] The Cephalopod Courtly Jacket, Whalebone Tattoo and Tentacled Terror Tattoo are all available from the Outpost clothing shops for those with enough gold to spare.
[*] Outpost weapon shops now carry a range of armaments from the hand-carved Carpenter’s weapon set.
[*] Outpost weapon shops also stock a selection of heavy swords and rapiers from the Kraken, Inky Kraken and Venomous Kraken sets, locked behind their associated Commendations.[/list][b]New Throwing Knives[/b][list]
[*] The Outpost weaponsmiths now stock a choice of new throwing knives, all locked behind lofty accomplishments.
[*] The Cartographer Throwing Knives are unlocked upon completion of the Triple Threat Thrower Commendation, the Guardians of Fortune Throwing Knives unlock at Allegiance level 50 with the Guardians of Fortune, and the Servants of the Flame Throwing Knives unlock at Allegiance level 50 with the Servants of the Flame.[/list][b]Season Six Legacy Cosmetics[/b][list]
[*] Cosmetics previously available during Season Six have arrived in Outpost shops and can now be yours in exchange for Doubloons!
[*] Players can now purchase the Naval Commander clothing set, along with a range of unique one-off items that were available during this Season. Pirate Legends can also pick up Belle’s Hat and Stranger’s Cutlass.
[*] The time-limited Dark Relics items, however, remain exclusive to players who participated in Season Six.[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Improvements[/h3]
[b]Post-Defeat Ship Sinking[/b][list]
[*] Once a ship is destroyed, the time taken for it to sink and release its cargo has been reduced, allowing the sunk crew to interact with the mermaid and head to their new location more quickly.
[*] While each ship previously had a unique sinking time, this update brings them to consistently shorter post-defeat sinking times.[/list][b]Bone Caller Skeleton Improvements[/b][list]
[*] Summoned Bone Caller Skeletons will no longer uncover players using a hide emote to hide in plain sight.
[*] Players being chased by Bone Caller Skeletons will now be able to hide if they are able to lose line of sight and complete the hide emote before being found.
[*] Players can now lure Bone Caller Skeletons to a location by firing a weapon and hiding again, causing the skeletons to patrol the location of the sound.[/list]
[h3]Fixed Issues[/h3]
[b]Gameplay[/b][list]
[*] When boarding a ship from the sea, players can no longer silence the boarding audio effects by grabbing the ladder while repeatedly holding out items, ensuring nearby players will always hear the signs that someone is boarding from the water.
[*] Players can once again summon text chat after rebinding it to either the C key on the keyboard or R3 button on PlayStation®5.
[*] Crews diving for an Hourglass battle as a Grade 1 Emissary, and earning enough following a win to skip straight to Grade 3, will now correctly progress Commendations that required Grade 2 status to unlock.
[*] Crews are no longer able to vote down an Emissary Flag in the short window after the sinking death knell is heard and before the ship is destroyed.
[*] The Gold Hoarders Boots can now be found in the correct shop at Outposts.
[*] Players using a mermaid to leave a stormy area and return to their ship should no longer find themselves sometimes unfortunately struck by lightning when arriving back on their ship.
[*] Snakes caught inside crates will now attack players when held and stationary.[/list][b]Performance and Stability[/b][list]
[*] Players should no longer experience scenarios where the sea becomes frozen or reduced to moving slowly, significantly affecting gameplay.
[*] Further improvements have been made to game stability to reduce scenarios where players unexpectedly exit the game or become disconnected from their session.[/list][b]The War Chest[/b][list]
[*] The Twin Shot Target Commendation is now visible in the War Chest when progress has not yet been made.
[*] Bone Caller Skeletons roaming a ship now offer a short grace period before attacking players returning from the Ferry of the Damned.
[*] Throwing a knife at a blocking player will now display the correct visual effects.
[*] Players can now retrieve Deadlock Jailer Throwing Knives embedded in the environment without having throwing knives in their loadout.
[*] When a charged shot is fired from a Double Barrel Pistol, the animation no longer shows the hammer being primed before reloading, allowing the weapon to now reload more quickly.[/list][b]Visual and Audio[/b][list]
[*] When a player boards a ship, the audio cue is now only heard around the vicinity of the ladder and not from further away.
[*] Battle music during Faction Battles will now continue to be heard after a player has died and returned from the Ferry of the Damned.
[*] Several wheels have been improved to prevent players’ hands from intersecting with the handles when turning.
[*] Pigs caught in a Pig Crate will now appear at the correct size.
[*] Transitioning from a Sleep or Sit Emote to any other emote now updates the camera zoom point correctly.
[*] When wielding a pocket watch, players will now flick the watch open.
[*] Improvements have been made to the blade textures of the Gold Leaf Cutlass.
[*] Performing the Scrappy Weapon Pose Emote no longer causes players' hands to intersect with throwing knives.
[*] When a player is observed using a spyglass, the item should no longer intersect with their head when looking towards the ground.
[*] The grog inside the Evening Tide Tankard now appears correctly.
[*] The Legendary Spirit Pistol should now fire in line with the pistol’s centre point when aiming.
[*] Larger pirates wearing the Paradise Garden Costume should now fit snugly without visible seams.
[*] The colour of the Frozen Horizon Frigid Hair tips is now maintained when a headband is equipped. 
[*] Placing the Scrivener’s Writing Set on a ship now results in it sitting neatly in place.
[*] [b]‘The Lair of LeChuck’[/b] – The skull that Guybrush finds in the catacombs now sits in his hands while animating.
[*] [b]‘The Quest for Guybrush’[/b] – When unlocking the Summon the Beast shanty, the notification now shows the correct iconography.[/list][b]Environment [/b][list]
[*] A visible hole in the Vault wall at Fetcher’s Rest has been filled.
[*] Improvements have been made to the shorelines at Plunder Valley and Sailors’ Bounty to ensure the waves crash smoothly onto the beaches.
[*] Treasure dropped near the Vault doors on Sailor’s Knot Stronghold will no longer fall beneath ground level.
[*] Pets will no longer be automatically removed from hangout spots within the Pirate Legend Hideout.
[*] Floating items in the Shrine of Ocean’s Fortune have been removed.
[*] Players can now smoothly pass through a gap under one of the platforms on the eastern side of Skull Keep without getting stuck.
[*] [b]‘The Legend of Monkey Island’[/b] – Portrait Trinkets now only fit on certain hanging spots around the ships to prevent them from intersecting with other items.[/list][b]User Interface[/b][list]
[*] When attempting to invite players to a Guild, the invite menu should now consistently show all available friends.
[*] After navigating from the Discover tab on the Quest Table, returning to the Discover tab will retain focus on the previously selected option.
[*] Players diving to an encounter and receiving an extended wait in the Tunnels of the Damned will once again be shown notifications that the search is still in progress.[/list][b]Accessibility[/b][list]
[*] Players on PC using the ‘Toggle Radial Menus’ accessibility setting will no longer find that pressing the Q and E keys together causes the Game Options menu to become stuck on screen.[/list][b]Text and Localisation[/b][list]
[*] Players using French localisation will now find that the Seaposts have reverted to their English names as used previously.
[*] [b]‘The Fate of the Morningstar’[/b] – Improvements have been made to the Tall Tale Quest Books to resolve a range of text issues when playing in Japanese.[/list]
[h3]Known Issues[/h3]
To learn more about known issues in [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] currently being tracked and their status, head over to our [url=https://support.seaofthieves.com/hc/en-gb/sections/360000063027-Known-Issues]Known Issues support site article[/url].

[h3]Download and Installation[/h3]
[b]Download Size:[/b][list]
[*] Steam: 6.62 GB[/list]

notes.title: Sea of Thieves Round-Up: June 2024
notes.content:
It feels like barely a moment since we were last here, summing up the events of May, and yet the calendar is dutifully telling us that it is, in fact, now July. Who’d have thought? Well, on the off-chance the calendar isn’t lying, we should get around to rounding up June, shouldn’t we?

[h3]Content Update[/h3]
First up on the content front was a call from the Pirate Emporium shopkeepers to take advantage of the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/emporium-extravaganza]Emporium Extravaganza[/url] Event. In addition to an accompanying Hidden Gems Sale (swiftly followed by a [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1804091949864906764]second June sale[/url] to celebrate the three-year anniversary of [i]Sea of Thieves: A Pirate’s Life[/i]), all players claiming the free Self High Five Emote were automatically entered into the Extravaganza Raffle, with the entire available content of the Emporium up for grabs as top prize.

With that enticing setup on the line, it was time to dive straight into [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1801933232037888492]Season 12 Community Weekend[/url]! Filled with free [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1801933207471833433]items[/url] and [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1801933212303634610]Voyages[/url], [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1801933224379048279]streaming spoils[/url], [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1802075740080394583]picture-perfect poses[/url] and, of course, the all-important race to uncover [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1802075740080394583]Pop-Up Plunder[/url], the weekend was a blast and a celebration of everything that makes this community what it is. Yes, even the criminals who buried treasure in [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1802117887370662309]the spike pits[/url]. [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1802121846499811494]Especially them[/url].

After that, we were back to our regularly scheduled programming and a monthly content update fresh from the developers’ desks. In addition to a bracing bounty of Emporium stock, June’s update saw the team tweaking and reworking a number of areas to better balance the player experience, including ship speeds, Double Barrel Pistol stats and a clutch of recent Commendations. Be sure to give the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/release-notes/3.0.2]full release notes[/url] a read if you haven’t already to get all the details.

[previewyoutube=xwdA9K6PJok;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]News and Features[/h3]
Even with a myriad of other celebrations taking place throughout the month, we weren’t about to forget that June heralded Pride Month. That meant it was time for an updated profile picture – or not, as [url=https://x.com/RareLtd/status/1796561484648210857]the case may be[/url] – and a new [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C7rPkM2sjht/]stylish T-shirt[/url] to get your hands on! Our streaming soundtrack, meanwhile, was expanding with the inspirational [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1804061784757723381]‘Blessing of Athena’s Fortune’[/url].

As Season 12 Community Weekend rapidly approached, we spun up a dedicated article to lay out [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/season12-community-weekend]all the details[/url] of what players could expect. A while later, once the revelries had wrapped up, we returned to the scene for a detailed look back at what [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/season-12-community-weekend-lookback]everyone had got[/url] up to during the Event and, as always, to question which chaos merchants among you are eating all [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1802659333051666561]these Burnt Grubs[/url]. 

June’s community spirit also extended to another two Community Spotlights! First on the list was a buccaneer famed for his barnacle-based bearing, [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-fishhook-cook]Fishhook Cook[/url], who walked us through everything from his early start in gaming to a real-life pirate connection. Then, to close out Pride Month, we stopped by to chat with LGBTQIA+ advocate and brilliant Boatswain [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/news/community-spotlight-div-and-inc]Div_And_Inc[/url] to learn about their work supporting diversity across the seas. And fire breathing. It was a far-reaching conversation.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/d902d2df771cdb9384c62ad92d876b67651729b2.jpg[/img]
[h3]Videos and Streams[/h3]
There was a lot of gaming news going around in early June, as the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZZ6gafqCjsY]Xbox Games Showcase[/url] revealed a range of upcoming titles and updates for the year ahead. With Flameheart’s long-awaited return just around the corner, our own Video team wasn’t about to let the opportunity go by without dropping in [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fSKDlLjxR6M]a little Season 13 trailer[/url]… 

Closer to home, another instalment of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GlIssp5udME][i]Sea of Thieves[/i] News[/url] was due and that meant dragging Drew back in front of the camera to spill the beans about plans for ship speeds. Daryl wasn’t far away either, ready to fill everyone in on the promise of Season 12 Community Weekend plus the latest Emporium and Outpost additions.

Since Community Weekend relied on everyone getting those [i]Sea of Thieves[/i] Twitch viewing hours in, the Community team hauled themselves into the Rare Tavern on a Saturday for a [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2172710991]stream of their own[/url]. Dubbed The Trading Company Tour, it pitted four fabulously chaotic teams against each other in a timed race to earn Emissary value in whatever ways they saw fit. PvP battles? Sneaky trade deals? Desperate pleading for the Kraken to go away? Catch up on all of the above and more as the teams raked in millions for their chosen representatives.

[previewyoutube=fSKDlLjxR6M;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Social Channels[/h3]
Accompanying all the Event-based activity in June was a buzz of regular community content: the [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/community-hub]Community Hub[/url] saw two [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1797714204574548305]new refreshes[/url], showcasing some incredible [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C8mxbVTMy5p/?img_index=1]fan creations[/url], while keen snappers delighted in two more themes for our trusty #SoTShot contest. For the first, [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C76wWdnuVmY/]promising pirates[/url] posed in tranquil scenes of [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1799088010308231660]Island Life[/url], before we dispensed with the sense of serenity and got back to the usual [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/C8w-4uesTrt/?img_index=1]pirate pastime[/url] of [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1806719798211985606]Grog Guzzling[/url]. Cheers!

Not everyone was to be lauded, of course, as we suffered a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7377036332465524001]fishy betrayal[/url], endured the continued trials of [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7378948979645599008]unhelpful crewmates[/url] and had our [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1805902639839805804]naming abilities[/url] questioned. Even the sweet comfort of [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7377765150880845088]someone else’s loot[/url] wasn’t enough to dull our sadness and we turned to [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1802363546266738873]collecting Gunpowder Barrels[/url] instead. Explosions [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1802457411652862037]heal all wounds[/url], or something.

In better news, while we were busy digging through data to uncover everyone’s Community Weekend stats, we also happened to stumble across the [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/photo/7381857869039291681]pet name rosters[/url]. None of the top tens featured the word ‘Devil’, so clearly you’re all doing better than us. Once all the data crunching had worn us out, we had a quick hunt around for the best place to [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7384074180481879328]have a sit down[/url], then ended the day with a [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game/video/7382958755735981345]jolly singalong[/url]. Worth it.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37295600/86ba45a753de08eca912c8fdd64d8d66fe4bb40e.jpg[/img]
And so we reached the end of June! Big things are afoot across the waves and when we next stop by with a round-up, a new Season will have swept through the Sea of Thieves… Until then, however, we must bid you adieu! As always, you can find us in the usual places for regular updates:  [url=https://twitter.com/SeaOfThieves]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/SeaOfThievesGame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/seaofthievesgame]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@seaofthieves_game]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/seaofthieves]YouTube[/url], [url=https://twitch.tv/seaofthieves]Twitch[/url], or via the official [url=https://www.seaofthieves.com/forum]Forums[/url] and [url=https://www.discord.gg/seaofthieves]Discord[/url]. Now we really do have to leave you. We have [url=https://x.com/SeaOfThieves/status/1803105399815454750]rocks to sail into[/url].
